answer: Missing property: an idempotent write. Applying the same rows twice must leave one copy, but a plain INSERT appends every time, so the scheduler's retry after the failed success flag doubled the slice. Two safe designs: (1) Partition replace: DELETE the day's slice and INSERT it again in one transaction (or atomically swap the partition), so a retry rewrites identical rows. (2) MERGE on the natural key (e.g. charge_id) with a version guard, so a repeat matches existing rows instead of adding copies. Both assume the input is pinned and the transform is deterministic.
